propositions: Signed verdicts currently record only the model string, making it impossible for consumers to distinguish between first-class and best-effort provider tiers or detect gateway-backed models.
A backward-compatible additive provenance record must embed provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, and effective capabilities into signed verdicts without breaking legacy payload readers.

Provenance must be assembled once from runner-resolved capability records and reused throughout the verdict assembly pipeline rather than recomputed, to prevent silent divergence from the record that drove the run.
The endpoint_host field must extract only the hostname component via urlparse().hostname to prevent credential leakage from base_url strings containing userinfo.

Provenance records must reach sidecars through the complete production assembly path (finalize_verdict calls in workflow_ops and recovery paths) using already-computed step outputs, not hand-constructed verdict dicts.
